blocks.text: Reactants aur products ki tabee halaton ke lihaz se chemical equilibrium ki do qismein hain: homogeneous, jis mein sab species ek hi phase mein hain, aur heterogeneous, jis mein woh ek se zyada phases mein hain. Agla topic har ek ki misalein deta hai.

blocks.prompt: 2NO2(g) se N2O4(g) aur Fe3O4(s) + 4H2(g) se 3Fe(s) + 4H2O(g) ke equilibria ko homogeneous ya heterogeneous mein taqseem karein.
blocks.explanation: Pehla homogeneous hai, sab gases. Doosra heterogeneous hai, solids aur gases saath.

items: Phase ke lihaz se do qismein: homogeneous (ek phase) aur heterogeneous (ek se zyada phases).
